**Saint-Aubin clinic handover — nursing coordination**

- 4,200 patients; 6 rooms; Mon–Fri 08:00–19:00, Sat 09:00–13:00. 12 nurses (3 shifts), 4 admin.
- Accreditation: April 2022–April 2027; renewal needs infection-control audit.
- Attendance: 180/day average; 310 peak (Jan 2025 flu wave). No-shows 9%, down from 14% after Sept 2024 reminder texts.
- March 2024: fridge failure, €2,100 stock lost. Fixed: networked alarm, checked daily; paper log backup (alarm failed silently once).
- Nov 2024: concurrent record edit overwrote allergy field. Fixed: records lock while open.
- Rules: no renewal without consultation within 12 months (38 breaches found); vaccine stock counted twice weekly; excursions >8°C reported same day to regional agency.
- Second ultrasound: proposed June 2025, postponed pending utilisation study; not done; saturation unknown.
- Coordinator vacant since Aug 2025; two senior nurses rotating; unsustainable beyond winter.
